name: Adalaj Vav
description: Five-storey ornate stepwell from 1499. Indo-Islamic architecture with intricate carvings on every surface.

name: Calico Museum of Textiles
description: One of the world's finest textile museums. Mughal court fabrics, temple hangings, and regional weaving traditions.

name: Heritage Pol Walk (Old City)
description: Walking tour through 600-year-old pol houses with carved wooden facades, hidden temples, and shared courtyards.

name: Kankaria Lake
description: 15th-century polygonal lake with lakefront park, zoo, kids city, balloon ride, and toy train. Evening light show.

name: Manek Chowk Night Market
description: Daytime jewelry market transforms into a legendary street food bazaar at night. Pav bhaji, kulfi, dosas, and more.

name: Sabarmati Ashram
description: Gandhi's home from 1917-1930. The Dandi March started here. Museum with letters, spinning wheel, and personal items.

name: Science City
description: Interactive science museum with IMAX 3D, earthquake simulator, energy park, and robotics gallery.

name: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque (Tree of Life)
description: Famous for the stone jali (lattice) window depicting an intricate tree of life. IIM Ahmedabad logo inspiration.

name: Don Bosco Museum
description: Seven-story museum of indigenous cultures of Northeast India. 17 galleries with 14,000+ artifacts.

name: Elephant Falls
description: Three-tiered waterfall near Shillong. Named by British for an elephant-shaped rock (now destroyed).

name: Laitlum Canyons
description: Dramatic canyon meaning "End of Hills". Steep grassy slopes dropping into deep valleys with misty views.

name: Police Bazaar
description: Main shopping area of Shillong. Local handicrafts, traditional Khasi jewelry, and street food.

name: Shillong Peak
description: Highest point in Shillong at 6,449 ft. IAF radar station with panoramic views of the city and hills.

name: Umiam Lake (Barapani)
description: Large reservoir surrounded by East Khasi Hills. Water sports including kayaking, speed boating, and paddle boarding.

name: Ward's Lake
description: Horseshoe-shaped artificial lake in the heart of Shillong. Beautiful garden with wooden bridge.

name: Junagarh Fort
description: Unbreached fort built in 1593 by Raja Rai Singh. 37 palaces, pavilions, and temples inside.

name: Karni Mata Temple (Rat Temple)
description: Famous temple where thousands of rats (kabbas) are worshipped. One of India's most unusual temples.

name: National Camel Research Centre
description: Government camel breeding farm with hundreds of camels. Camel milk ice cream and lassi available.

name: Rampuria Havelis
description: Cluster of ornate merchant havelis with red sandstone and jharokha windows. Walking tour through old city.

name: Aru Valley
description: Alpine meadow at 7,500 ft. Base camp for Kolahoi Glacier and Tarsar-Marsar trek. Horse riding available.

name: Baisaran (Mini Switzerland)
description: Pine-covered meadow surrounded by forests and snow peaks. Horse ride or trek from Pahalgam town.

name: Betaab Valley
description: Named after Bollywood film "Betaab" (1983). Lush green valley with Lidder River and snow-capped peaks.

name: Chandanwari
description: Starting point of Amarnath Yatra. Snow-capped slopes where you can toboggan even in summer.

name: Buland Darwaza
description: World's tallest gateway at 54 meters. Built by Akbar to commemorate victory in Gujarat.

name: Panch Mahal
description: Five-story palatial structure with 176 columns, no two alike. Wind-catcher design for Mughal queens.

name: Tomb of Salim Chishti
description: Exquisite white marble tomb with finest jali (lattice) screens in India. Wish-fulfilling shrine.

name: Majuli Island Walk
description: World's largest river island. Cycle through paddy fields, wetlands, and traditional Mising tribal villages.

name: Mask Making at Samaguri Satra
description: Traditional Assamese mask-making workshop. Watch artisans create elaborate ritual masks from bamboo and clay.

name: Vaishnavite Satras (Monasteries)
description: Neo-Vaishnavite monasteries founded by Srimanta Sankaradeva. Kamalabari, Auniati, and Dakhinpat satras.

name: Sindh River Rafting
description: White-water rafting on the Sindh River through stunning valley with Class II-III rapids.

name: Thajiwas Glacier
description: Easily accessible glacier at 9,186 ft. Pony ride through alpine meadows to the glacier face.

name: Zoji La Pass View
description: Dramatic mountain pass at 11,575 ft connecting Kashmir to Ladakh. Gateway to Drass and Kargil.

name: Barton Museum
description: Collection of Harappan artifacts, coins, and manuscripts from the princely state era.

name: Takhteshwar Temple
description: Hilltop Shiva temple with panoramic views of Gulf of Cambay and Bhavnagar city.

name: Hoollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary
description: Only gibbon sanctuary in India. Home to the endangered hoolock gibbon — India's only ape species.

name: Tocklai Tea Research Institute
description: World's oldest and largest tea research station. Heritage tea gardens and processing unit tours.

name: Lothal Archaeological Museum
description: Artifacts from the Harappan era — seals, pottery, bead-making tools, and terracotta figures.

name: Lothal Archaeological Site
description: 4,500-year-old Indus Valley port with the world's oldest known dock. Bead factory, warehouse, and drainage system ruins.

name: Qila Mubarak
description: Heart of Patiala city. Fortified palace complex with Darbar Hall, Sheesh Mahal, and a clock tower.

name: Sheesh Mahal
description: Mirror palace housing a museum with miniature paintings, medals, and the famous Patiala necklace replica.

name: Mohan Shakti National Heritage Park
description: Modern heritage park with temples, Vedic library, and beautiful architecture set in pine forests.

name: Old Solan Brewery (Mohan Meakin)
description: Asia's oldest brewery established in 1855. Heritage building producing Old Monk rum and beer.

name: Bhoramdeo Main Temple
description: 11th-century Shiva temple in Maikal Hills. Intricate erotic sculptures and Gurur-style architecture.

name: Dzukou Valley Trek
description: Valley of flowers at 8,000 ft on the Nagaland-Manipur border. Carpet of lilies in July-September.

name: Namdapha National Park Trek
description: India's only park with four big cats (tiger, leopard, snow leopard, clouded leopard). Pristine eastern Himalayan biodiversity.

name: Tehri Lake Water Sports
description: Asia's largest man-made lake offering jet skiing, kayaking, banana rides, and speed boating.
